column1: # agents-prices.tsv — prices for the estimate in `agents report --view tokens`.
# tuidev ships no prices: they change, and they depend on your plan. Copy this
# ~/.config/agents.conf at another path), then add one line per model from the
# Format: one model per line, tab- or space-separated, # starts a comment:
# each price in US dollars per million tokens: input, cache writes (Anthropic's
# cache-creation price; 0 for OpenAI, which has none), cache reads (OpenAI's
# cached input) and output. A model takes the line whose prefix is the longest
# match of its name (claude-opus-5 matches claude-opus-5-5); of a prefix listed
# twice, the later line wins. A malformed line is reported and ignored.
# The report then adds an "EST $" column and a total, labelled as an estimate,
# with "-" for models no line matches. On a subscription plan the dollars are
# what the same tokens would cost on the API, not what you pay. Without this
# file, the report shows tokens only.
